supersedes_reason: The user expanded and reprioritized acceptance: the current UI must be more compact in a Notion-like direction and satisfy twelve explicit shell, Board, project-detail, counter and scrolling requirements. The two newly supplied Downloads images override the older density and top-row criteria while existing behavior and architecture remain binding.
goal: Refine the running Workspace Electron UI into a compact, coherent Notion-like interface guided by the supplied Board and expanded-project references, satisfy all twelve stated layout and behavior requirements, preserve data and actions, and deliver matched native before/after evidence plus a verified local commit.
hypothesis: A shared compact shell and component-scale pass, combined with a single Board vertical scroll model and normalized project-detail typography/insets, will remove the reported density, alignment and scroll defects without changing product behavior or storage boundaries; native full-window pairs and behavior probes will show every stated requirement satisfied or identify a concrete exception.
scope: Workspace renderer UI, shared renderer components, focused tests and UI handoff evidence; isolated visual fixtures and native full-window captures. No live user project changes, dependency change unless proven necessary, storage, IPC, Electron security, project identity, status rules, backend, push, merge or release.
measurement_plan: Before implementation, preserve the two 1486x1059 reference images and capture the current isolated Electron build at 1440x960 and 1024x720. Use the same fixture, view, tab set, search/filter state and project data for before/after pairs. Evaluate the twelve requirements by named UI anchors and falsifying observations: control-center alignment with macOS traffic lights, stable Board/project content start, no clipping or overlap, one shared Board vertical scroll plus retained horizontal scroll, column height following content, visible counts derived from filtered cards, common project-detail type/inset, and stable settings/tab spacing. Do not invent a pixel similarity threshold. Native CoreGraphics full-window evidence is required for visual checks; CDP may supply DOM, accessibility and scroll-state diagnostics but cannot replace the native pair. Verify persistence and actions with isolated fixture data, then run npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build:renderer and git diff --check.

checks.description: npm test, npm run typecheck, npm run build:renderer and git diff --check pass; the diff introduces no storage, IPC, Electron security, project-ID or status-rule change. Any failed command or prohibited boundary change falsifies the check.

Native open/collapsed sidebar captures and interaction probes satisfy requirements 1-5, 9 and 10: reference-like semantic icons, stable content start between Board/project, unobstructed clickable collapsed toggle, traffic lights/toggle/right actions on one visual centerline, truncating workspace title, bottom-anchored Settings with small inset and compact tab gaps. Any overlap, missing action, pushed-out control, content jump or unstable bottom gap falsifies.

On variable-height isolated data the Board has one vertical scroll that moves all columns together, retains horizontal Board scroll, gives columns content-driven height with a compact empty column, and displays each column's visible-card count after search/filter. An independently scrolling column, full-viewport empty background, lost horizontal scroll or stale count falsifies.

In native expanded-project evidence the project title, Properties and Hidden properties use the same text size and weight; title, properties and file tree share one left inset; file-tree count is visually only the number while its accessible name describes the item count. A visibly different heading treatment, misaligned anchor or exposed count phrase falsifies.

Board, table, tabs, menus, settings and editors use a consistent compact type/control/card/padding/gap scale at 1440x960 and 1024x720 while labels remain readable, focus remains visible and interactive targets remain practical. A clipped label/action, unreadable text, invisible focus, or one materially unscaled surface falsifies.

On isolated fixture data, Board/Table switching, search/filter counts, project open/duplicate/restore/close, tabs, properties, settings, keyboard access and reload persistence continue to work. Any lost action, changed data, status-rule violation or failed persistence probe falsifies.

Settled CoreGraphics full-window before/after evidence exists for 1440x960 and 1024x720 covering Board, expanded project, open/collapsed sidebar, variable-height columns and long names/many tabs, with provenance and a twelve-row evidence map. Missing full-window pair, transition frame, browser substitution or unlabeled exception falsifies.

A scoped local commit contains the verified product changes and linked run artifacts, reports exact checks and remaining limits, and is independently audited from frozen hashes. Missing commit/artifacts, uncommitted product changes or misleading evidence labels falsify.
